Check a lab, a chapter or a whole course

Source: R/toolkit-check.R
check_material.Rd

Runs a teaching material the way students will meet it and reports what works. Run it after every edit, and after swap_lab_data().

Usage

check_material(path, render = FALSE, quiet = TRUE)

Arguments

path

a lab folder, a chapter .Rmd file or a course folder.

render

also render the material with rmarkdown::render(), which catches problems in the Markdown and YAML as well as the code. Slower.

quiet

suppress the progress messages.

Value

A tibble with one row per check: material, check ("structure", "data", "chunk", "exercise" or "render"), label, status ("pass", "fail" or "skip") and message. all(result$status != "fail") is TRUE when the material is ready.

Details

For a lab (a folder with a learnr .Rmd), it checks that chunk labels are unique and that every -solution, -hint and -check chunk belongs to an exercise; runs the setup chunk and every chunk that runs when the lab is rendered (including the multiple-choice questions); and runs each exercise's solution (or its starting code, when there is no solution) followed by its -check chunk through lab_checker(), so a solution that its own check rejects is reported. For a chapter (an .Rmd file), it runs every chunk in order. For a course folder (with course.json), it checks every material in course_materials().

Everything runs in a temporary copy, so nothing in your folder changes.

See also

new_lab(), preview_lab()

Examples

# \donttest{
course <- file.path(tempdir(), "check-demo")
lab <- new_lab("demo", data = expand.table(LSAT7), course = course,
               sections = c("intro", "classical"))
check_material(lab)
#> # A tibble: 7 × 5
#>   material check     label           status message                             
#>   <chr>    <chr>     <chr>           <chr>  <chr>                               
#> 1 demo     structure labels          pass   11 chunks, all labels unique.       
#> 2 demo     data      data            pass   1000 people, 5 items.               
#> 3 demo     chunk     setup           pass   Runs.                               
#> 4 demo     chunk     all             pass   Every chunk that runs at render tim…
#> 5 demo     exercise  intro-look      pass   Each row is a person and each colum…
#> 6 demo     exercise  classical-means pass   Right. The easiest item is Item.5 a…
#> 7 demo     exercise  classical-stats pass   Look down the cor_if_rm (or total.r…
# }
